properties.name: pqscan:rationale
properties.value: RSA signing is deprecated after 2030 and disallowed after 2035 (NIST IR 8547 Table 2). Migrate signing to ML-DSA (FIPS 204); dual/hybrid signatures are a transitional option; verifiers and certificate chains must be able to accept ML-DSA before signers switch.

properties.name: pqscan:reason
properties.value: operation .sign() -> SIGN; receiver resolved: pyca:RSA:private:parameter; arguments: padding=PKCS1v15

properties.name: pqscan:parameterSet
properties.value: ML-DSA-65 (category 3) by default; ML-DSA-44 only with an RBG of >= 192-bit strength if category 2 is required; ML-DSA-87 for category 5

properties.name: pqscan:target
properties.value: ML-DSA (FIPS 204); SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) where its size/speed trade-offs are acceptable

properties.name: pqscan:rationale
properties.value: Add ML-DSA (FIPS 204) verification so that migrated signers can be accepted. NIST IR 8547 defines 'legacy use' as processing already-protected data such as verifying an existing signature; whether RSA verification of already-issued signatures keeps that status after 2035 is set by SP 800-131A (to be revised). Retain legacy verification only for already-issued signatures; do not accept new RSA signatures after the transition.
